result.summary: Found 1 major content issue where a promotional discount badge displays an invalid '-100%' value.

issues.description: The second restaurant card under the 'Popular right now' section displays a '-100%' discount badge in the top-left corner, which indicates a calculation error or broken promotional data.
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount calculation logic and promotional data source to ensure valid discount percentages are displayed, or hide the badge when no valid discount applies.
